map.自查页面是否被过度优化：统计核心词出现占比，若明显高于同题材正常水平，可能被搜索: Self-check whether a page is over-optimized: count the share of the core term; if it is clearly above the normal level for the same topic, search engines may judge it as stuffing.
map.选择分词模式：中文选按字符或 2-gram，英文选按空格: Choose the tokenization mode: by character or 2-gram for Chinese, by space for English
map.设置最小词长，过滤掉单字或过短词: Set a minimum word length to filter out single characters or overly short words
map.按需开启过滤停用词与区分大小写: Enable stop-word filtering and case sensitivity as needed
map.看结果时别只盯百分比，先看总词数——样本太小时密度没有参考意义: When reading the results, do not stare only at the percentage - look at the total word count first; with too small a sample the density is meaningless
map.更实际的判断是与同题材优质页面对比：若你的密度明显高于它们且读起来生硬，就应下调: A more practical judgment is to compare against strong pages on the same topic: if your density is clearly higher and reads awkwardly, lower it
map.写作时应优先保证语句自然、同义词与相关词覆盖充分，而不是把目标词反复塞进去: When writing, prioritize natural sentences with good coverage of synonyms and related terms, rather than repeatedly cramming in the target word
map.不是，堆砌会被判作弊。: No, keyword stuffing will be judged as cheating.
